annotations.title: Scan a site for AI and crawler readiness

description: Scans a domain now (5-15 seconds) and returns its graded record: grade, score, section scores and findings. CrawlCheck's scanner sends other crawlers' user-agent strings, so site logs show those names; they are not visits by those crawlers. A domain scanned in the last 2 minutes returns that report, marked reused: true with its scanned_at. A null grade means not measured, not low.

domain.description: A bare domain such as example.com, or a full URL
